name: Pet/Pal System
description: Companion creatures (Pals) that fight alongside the player in combat. Pals inherit the player's ATK and apply their own damage multipliers. They are equipped to position slots, leveled up, and enhanced through talent and proficiency systems. Pal combat damage is calculated using the parent player's ATK rather than the pal's own ATK stat.

battle_loading.description: Loads equipped pets into the battle unit array during combat initialization.
process: 1. Get list of equipped pets (pet_list or getWearPetList())
2. Load attribute definitions from configAttribute.getDataByList('module', 1)
3. For each pet with pet_id != 0:
a. Look up ConfigPet by pet_id to get unitId
b. Look up ConfigPetlevel by (pet_id, pet_level) to get stat values
c. Create new battle unit with attribs dictionary
d. For each attribute in module=1: baseValue = getPetFactAttrValue(bonusData, petlevel[attr.key], pet_id, attr.id)
4. INHERIT stats from parent player unit (player.units[0]):
- hp = player.hp
- att = player.att (ATK)
- partner_dam_extra = player.partner_dam_extra
- skill_dam_extra = player.skill_dam_extra (server version only)
- skill_crit_rate = player.skill_crit_rate (server version only)
- skill_crit_dam = player.skill_crit_dam (server version only)
- boss_dam = player.boss_dam (server version only)
5. Set idleIndex = pet_pos + 1 (position slot determines battle index)
6. Push unit to player's units array

getPetFactAttrValue.description: Core formula that calculates final attribute values for pets, applying proficiency and talent bonuses with group-based multiplicative scaling.
algorithm: 1. Start with base value from ConfigPetlevel config (e.g., partner_dam at current level)
2. Add pet-specific attribute bonus: getPetAttrByAttrId(bonusMap, petId, attrId)
3. Add global (shared) attribute bonus: getPetAttrByAttrId(bonusMap, 0, attrId)
4. Look up attribute group multipliers: configAttribute.getDataByList('group', attrId)
5. If no group multipliers exist, return the additive result
a. Sum pet-specific + global group bonus for that group's attr
c. Multiply running total: result = roundInt(result * multiplier)
getPetFactAttrValue.formula_pseudocode:
result = base + petBonus[petId][attrId] + petBonus[0][attrId]
for each groupAttr in configAttribute.getGroupList(attrId):
  groupBonus = petBonus[petId][groupAttr.id] + petBonus[0][groupAttr.id]
  multiplier = round(groupBonus / 10000) + 1
  result = roundInt(result * multiplier)
return result
notes: The bonusMap (petCfgIdToAttr) is populated from server data via updatePetAttrInfo(petId, attrList)
petCfgIdToAttr[0] stores global bonuses shared across all pets
Group-based scaling is MULTIPLICATIVE, not additive - each group multiplier compounds

pet_combat_damage.description: Pal damage uses the PARENT player's ATK, not the pal's own ATK stat. The pal's partner_dam acts as a multiplier on the parent's attack.
pet_combat_damage.basic_attack_formula:
base_raw = max(roundInt(PARENT_ATK - target_DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1)
pal_mult = round(PARTNER_DAM * PARTNER_DAM_EXTRA)
resistance = calSuppressAndInspire(target, parent, PARTNER_RESIST)
pal_dmg = roundInt(base_raw * round(pal_mult * round(1 - resistance)))
if CRIT: pal_dmg *= max(1.5, round(CRIT_DAM / max(0.5, CRIT_DEF)))
result = max(1, pal_dmg)
pet_combat_damage.combo_attack_formula:
base_raw = max(roundInt(PARENT_ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1)
pal_mult = round(PARTNER_DAM * PARTNER_DAM_EXTRA)
pal_base = roundInt(base_raw * pal_mult) * round(1 - resistance)
pal_combo = roundInt(roundInt(pal_base) * DOUBLE_HIT_DAM)

key_attributes.description: Pal's base damage multiplier from ConfigPetlevel (base 10000)

position_system.description: Pets are equipped to numbered position slots (1-6). Each slot has unlock conditions.

condition_types.1: ROLE_LEVEL - requires player to reach a specific level
condition_types.2: TASK_PROGRESS - requires completion of specific tasks
condition_types.3: CHAPTER - requires reaching a specific chapter

position_system.battle_index: idleIndex = pet_pos + 1 (position slot determines the unit's combat ordering)

talent_system.description: Each pet has talent slots defined in ConfigPet.talent. Talents are grouped by type and unlock at star thresholds.

proficiency_system.description: Each talent type has a proficiency track with EXP progression. Higher proficiency grants extra stars and attribute bonuses.
proficiency_system.data_structure: Player pet data stores proficiency as array: [{worker_type: type_id, proficiency_lv: level, proficiency_exp: exp}, ...]
proficiency_system.exp_calculation: progress = current_exp - current_level_threshold; needed = next_level_threshold - current_level_threshold
proficiency_system.attribute_display: own_attrs array from ConfigPet_proficiency shows bonuses as [[attr_id, value], ...]

level_system.description: Pets are leveled using materials defined in ConfigPetlevel.expend
level_system.max_level_check: If no next level config exists, pet is at max level for current state

compose_system.description: Max-level pets can be composed/merged to create higher quality pets via ConfigMix.
process: 1. Pet must be at max level (no next level in ConfigPetlevel)
2. Look up ConfigMix using the material item ID from the last level's expend
3. ConfigMix provides: cost amount and required quality of sacrifice pet
4. Need another pet of quality = ConfigMix.quality + 1
5. Pay the ConfigMix.cost amount of the material

network_protocol.note: Pet system uses the PetControl class for network requests (reqPetSetPos, reqPetLevUp)
key_operations: reqPetSetPos(petId, posId) - equip/unequip pet to position (0 = unequip)
